repository_identity_limit: Commit/blob/path proofs use local Git object stores configured with the recorded mathlib4 origin URLs. No remote object authentication or network access occurred.
scope_limits: This is a byte-provenance ledger, not a batch semantic review.
Unmatched versions may include local edits, unrelated original work, unavailable upstream versions, renames, or other sources; none is classified as original merely by absence of a match.
The inspected upstream commits may postdate a captured file. Equality does not establish which author or repository supplied the bytes first.
Original upstream notices and user-directed provisional attribution require separate source-specific review.
Exact equality of empty or other common content is nonattributive; no file is assigned authorship or copying direction by this ledger.
Four exact upstream Python/YAML payloads have misleading .lean capture suffixes and are expressly outside Lean mathematical conceptual review.
